svg.title: Deployed enterprise agent Zero Trust control and evidence paths
svg.desc: Authors work. Separate SPIRE issuance and principal delegation feed an attested caller and the policy administrator. The gateway mediates requests; OPA decides, the PA atomically enforces and dispatches private tools. Injection and stolen bearer credentials enter at distinct boundaries. Independent host checkpoints and committed tool-state evidence support verification.

g.text: Deployed C2 control path and independent evidence boundaries
Identity authenticity and action legitimacy are separate; bearer-token theft and content injection enter at different points.
TRUSTED HOST | Dashboard, orchestration, model planning and independent evidence
CONTROL AND IDENTITY SERVICES | Separate internal control and identity networks
OFFLINE HOST ANALYSIS | Host files and independent anchors are outside client access
Fixed task, scope, seed and run clock
LLM planning / tool-call loop runs here
Provider API receives mock content only
Host files; no service volume mount
Read committed tool state + write IDs
C0 instead uses a non-expiring key
No route to tools or control state
Only PA joins this private network
Cannot attest or obtain fresh tokens
Per-request sequence / previous hash / credential / action / result
C2: principal, task, delegation, origin, provenance, policy decision
Host captures full logs; PA memory retains only a bounded tail
Score against independent ground truth; preserve null findings
Compare hash chain with independent checkpoint
Alter / middle delete / tail delete / all delete / reorder
Raw / processed CSV, JSON, SVG and bundles
Collection, model/date, config and source hashes
Trusted task delegation: principal, scope, expected intent and workflow budgets
Host-only committed-state read; no agent/attacker access
Fig. 1. Deployed identity, delegation, decision/enforcement and evidence paths (authors’ work).
Actual dispatch is gateway → PA → tools; the PA contains the serialized tool-side enforcement. Clients cannot bypass the gateway.
